hooks.text: 分支招式会随推进持续解锁，而敌人同步增强，迫使连段和防伤能力一起升级
hooks.excerpt: Power through different stages, fighting off enemies with your branching power moves, while avoiding to get hit yourself. The more you progress, the more combat moves you unlock, while at the same time the enemies get harder too!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 不同敌人拥有独立战斗风格，需记住完整招式并提前预判下一击
hooks.excerpt: A variety of enemies , each with a unique design and fighting style. Learn all their moves and predict their strikes ahead of time!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 女祭司中陷阱失去魔法后逐步恢复能力，沿城堡关卡追击邪眼完成复仇
hooks.excerpt: After infiltrating his castle, she falls victim to a powerful trap and loses her magic. Just as hope seems lost, she’s rescued by a mysterious healer who helps her recover and regain her abilities. Now, Minori must fight her way through enemy-filled stages, each offering new challenges.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
